hints.title: Word Normalization and Exclusion
hints.text: Normalize words to lowercase, strip punctuation, and tally occurrences while excluding prohibited entries.

hints.title: Punctuation Replacement
hints.text: Replace all non-alphanumeric characters with spaces to cleanly extract word tokens.

hints.title: Banned Set Frequency Query
hints.text: Collect banned tokens into a hash set for constant time filtering, maintain token frequencies, and return the key with maximum count.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter
import re
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def mostCommonWord(self, paragraph: str, banned: List[str]) -> str:
        banned_set = set(banned)
        words = re.findall(r'\w+', paragraph.lower())
        counts = Counter(w for w in words if w not in banned_set)
        return counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
```

complexity.notes: Regex word tokenization followed by frequency map counting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking each token against banned list sequentially without set hashing adds O(N * B) overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map stores counts of distinct non-banned words.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use regex or manual punctuation delimiters to parse tokens cleanly.
